name: Snickers Bar Smoothie

ingredients.name: peeled frozen ripe banana, cut into 4 pieces

instructions.primary_message: In a large skillet, toast oats over medium heat, stirring constantly, until lightly browned and nutty in fragrance, about 1 minute and 30 seconds. Transfer to a shallow plate to cool.

In a blender, blend 1 1/4 cups almond milk, bananas, ice cubes, dates, sugar or honey (if using), vanilla extract, cocoa powder, 1/4 cup peanut butter, and cooled toasted oats until smooth, about 1 minute. Pour evenly into 2 cups.

For Serving: If desired, mix remaining 1 tablespoon peanut butter with remaining 2 teaspoons almond milk until a smooth syrup forms. Drizzle peanut butter mixture evenly over top of each glass. Garnish with cacao nibs and sprinkle with crushed peanuts, if desired.

description: This Snickers-inspired smoothie blends peanut butter, dates, cocoa, toasted oats, and banana into a creamy, satisfying drink that's equally suited for breakfast, a snack, or dessert.
notes:
Optional or for serving: 2 teaspoons light brown sugar, raw sugar, or honey (optional); 1 teaspoon cacao nibs for topping, optional; Crushed peanuts, for topping, optional

Optional substitutions: quick cooking → old-fashioned rolled oats; unsweetened almond milk → your preferred milk

Notes: While we prefer almond milk here for its mild, slightly nutty flavor, any milk will work well in its place, including oat, soy, coconut, or dairy milk.

Make-ahead and storage: This smoothie is best enjoyed immediately after blending.
author: Leah Colins
